newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate falls, baht firmer late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate falls, baht firmer late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate fell to 9.75-10.00 percent in late trade on Friday from 11.25-11.50 in early morning and 11.50-12.00 late on Thursday as liquidity continued to rise, dealers said.
"The money supply was very high today. Some banks might bring in foreign funds," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
Dealers said the demand for funds was also slow today as banks are normally reluctant to borrow funds at the week end.
The baht edged higher to 25.509-25.514 to the dollar from 25.520-25.512 in the early morning on some dollar selling, dealers said.
"There was some selling of the dollar here in line with the U.S. unit's weakness abroad," one currency dealer said. "But the market remained dull."
The one-month dollar/baht swap premium declined to 8.75/9.25 satangs per dollar late against 9.25/9.75 in early morning due to higher liquidity.
The Bank of Thailand fixed the baht/dollar mid-rate at 25.50 to the dollar compared with 25.49 on Thursday.
